title: Compatible spectrum presentations of one affine open along a directed limit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preordered set, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ a diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], $c$ a limiting cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $i_0\in I$, and $W\subset D(i_0)$ an affine open. Write $J=\{i\in I\mid i_0\le i\}$ and $o=(i_0,i_0\le i_0)$. There are a functor $F:J\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ and an isomorphism $e_0:W\cong\operatorname{Spec}(F(o))$ such that for every $i\in J$ there is an isomorphism $e_i:W_i\cong\operatorname{Spec}(F(i))$, where $W_i$ is the inverse image of $W$ under $D(i\to i_0)$, and $e_0\circ(W_i\to W)=\operatorname{Spec}(F(o\to i))\circ e_i$. There is also an isomorphism $e_L:W_L\cong\operatorname{Spec}(\operatorname{colim}F)$, where $W_L$ is the inverse image of $W$ under $c_L\to D(i_0)$, such that $e_0\circ(W_L\to W)=\operatorname{Spec}(\iota_o)\circ e_L$, with $\iota_o$ the colimit coprojection. All maps from inverse-image opens to $W$ are restrictions of the specified structure maps.

proof.text: Set J={i | i₀ ≤ i} and o=(i₀, refl). The functor K:Jᵒᵖ → Over(op i₀) sends i to its order arrow; it is initial by Functor.initial_of_exists_of_isCofiltered, since every over-object is represented and the base preorder has subsingleton hom sets. Set E=K ⋙ opensDiagram D (op i₀) W and F=E.rightOp ⋙ Scheme.Γ. Every E(i) is affine by IsAffineOpen.preimage. Identify E(o) with W by Scheme.isoOfEq applied to D.map(id)⁻¹(W)=W. Compose its inverse with E(o).isoSpec to define e0. Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality gives every stage compatibility; the restrictions agree after composition with W.ι, which is mono.

Whisker opensCone D c (op i₀) W by K. Initiality and isLimitOpensCone prove this cone cE limiting. Scheme.isAffine_of_isLimit makes its vertex affine. Taking the right-opposite cone and using preservesColimit_Γ gives a colimit cocone on F with vertex Γ(cE.pt). Let eΓ be its coconePointUniqueUpToIso with the chosen colimit. Define eL=cE.pt.isoSpec followed by Spec.mapIso eΓ.symm.op. The comparison identity comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_inv at o identifies the composite of the coprojection and eΓ.inv with the global-sections map of cE.π(o). Applying Spec and Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality gives the limit compatibility; composition with the mono W.ι identifies its restricted leg with the required resLE. No nonemptiness of W is used.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof by M1: reindex the Mathlib affine-open cone using an initial upper-tail functor, and compare the global-sections colimit using preservesColimit_Γ. The original unit route is unchanged; this node is not a realized unit statement or step.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineOpen_directedRingSystem
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I)
    (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) :
    ∃ (F : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i} ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
      (e0 : W.toScheme ≅ Spec (F.obj ⟨i₀, le_rfl⟩)),
      (∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i},
        ∃ e : (D.map (homOfLE i.property).op ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme ≅ Spec (F.obj i),
          (D.map (homOfLE i.property).op).resLE W _ le_rfl ≫ e0.hom =
            e.hom ≫ Spec.map (F.map (homOfLE i.property))) ∧
      ∃ eL : (c.π.app (op i₀) ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme ≅ Spec (colimit F),
        (c.π.app (op i₀)).resLE W _ le_rfl ≫ e0.hom =
          eL.hom ≫ Spec.map (colimit.ι F ⟨i₀, le_rfl⟩)
